title: solar server completed at Deurendis
content: Begun during the first Earth Camp in August 2025, the solar web server is now installed at Deurendis in New York.
linkText: what resources did we need to build the solar server?

title: Earth Camp 2025
content: For three days, folks gathered in person at Deurendis in New York to share research and build a solar web server. There's more to do, but the solar server is almost complete and will be installed at Deurendis and will be available for public use soon.
